subject: Residual coverage shortfall — owner assignment & action grid
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Residual coverage shortfall — owner assignment & action grid

Team —

Quick summary: after today's forecast pull we are ~3.2M short of the Q3 coverage target when we map weighted pipeline to commit buckets. I've attached a snapshot and a raw CSV export (pipeline_export_20260727.csv / coverage_snapshot_07-27.xlsx).

Ask list (EOD Wednesday):
- Ben: update stage and expected close month for the 6 deals flagged in column "ActionOwner"; prioritize any ACV that can be accelerated to August.
- Neha: coordinate with Finance on any push/pull on recognized revenue assumptions for mid-market deals listed.
- Laura: scrub stages for the three opportunities in Legal (we need signed terms to consider as commit).

I've pre-populated an action grid in the coverage snapshot with suggested owners and an initial confidence score. Please add one-line notes for each assigned account explaining the gating blocker (e.g., procurement review, POC scheduling, budget sign-off).

We need a clean commit list for the FR (finance review) on Thursday morning — if we can't get signatures or firm POs, call them out and we'll use the fallback model.

Thanks,
Logan
Logan Wright
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

> Quick summary: after today's forecast pull we are ~3.2M short...

Thanks for the pull, Logan. I'm on the 6 deals flagged. Quick notes per account (short):
- NB-Cloud-Infra: Procurement pushed to Aug 9; buyer requested an updated capacity SOW (I can deliver by EOD Wed).
- NB-Analytics: Close cadence slipped, but customer agreed to an exec review next Mon; probability raised to 60%.
- NB-Security: Legal needs redlines addressed; counterparty asked for data residency clause.

Attached my working commit matrix with proposed close months and confidence (commit_matrix_v1.xlsx). I can take NB-Cloud-Infra and NB-Security as owners for the next 72h.

Ben
Ben Carter

Redwood Inference

Ben / Logan —

Thanks for the update and the matrix. A couple of clarifying asks from Finance / Procurement:
1) For NB-Cloud-Infra we need the exact MRC/MAC schedule and the draft SOW before Aug 6 to align internal approvals.
2) On data residency — security has asked for a short appendix that describes where tokenized logs are stored and retention settings. Can Redwood provide a one-page summary?

Procurement will start a parallel review once we have those two items. Happy to set a 30-min sync if helpful.

Megan Liu
Head of Finance, Northbridge Systems
m.megan@northbridge.com

Megan —

I'll take point with Finance on the revenue recognition assumptions and can pull the draft SOW language for MRC/MAC scheduling. Ben — please share the current pricing tables you presented; I'll confirm the billing cadence and any deferred rev implications.

Also looping Legal (via Laura) to prioritize the residency appendix; Laura, can you draft a concise paragraph we can send to Megan and her security lead? If we land that today, Procurement can be engaged formally.

Director, FP&A

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Residual coverage shortfall — owner assignment & action grid

Great thread — appreciate the quick responses. Final asks and next steps: 
- Ben: deliver the SOW draft and updated pricing table to Neha by EOD today; update HubSpot stages and expected close date (link below).
- Laura: produce the one-paragraph data residency appendix and upload to the shared Drive folder; cc procurement@northbridge.com on the note.
- Neha: confirm recognition assumptions and whether any deals need reclassifying from commit->best-case by tomorrow morning.

I'll compile the FR pack and circulate to Finance by 9am Thu. If we get signed MOU or PO before that, mark as commit and attach signed_mou_redwood_nb.pdf to the HubSpot deal record.

Links: HubSpot deal — https://hubspot.com/deal/NB-2026-Q3-Expand; Drive folder — https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0A1coverage/notes; DocuSign — https://www.docusign.com/Envelope/Sign/NB-Expand-2026

Let's hit the EOD targets — call if any blockers.

Logan
